description: This source file defines a report module for 'Loan Security Status' within the ERPNext system. It contains functions to execute the report, generate columns, retrieve data from the database, and apply filters based on user input. The main purpose is to provide a detailed report on loan securities pledged, including related attributes like applicant, status, pledge time, and associated monetary values.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point that fetches report columns and data based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_columns(filters)
methods.description: Defines the columns structure for the report, including labels, field types, and options.

methods.name: get_data(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves data from the database about loan security pledges, applying any filters.

methods.name: get_conditions(filters)
methods.description: Constructs SQL conditions based on filters provided by the user.
